_about: The label ledger of the dry walk, read ONLY by scripts/tests/known_red.py (P1-a spec 3.6): `known_red` holds one row per walk-row id (`<key|route|joint|kind>/<variant>`) that is red today because of a defect of main - `{node, raised_by[, note]}` - and `pins.known_red` is the number of rows (equality, both directions). Empty until the walk nodes (N3, N4) measure their first red rows; a raise is named in raised_by of the row.
